thread:
incident-bot: [P1] Alert: KV_CACHE_PAGE_FAULTS and swap_activity high on prod-eu-central-1 (cont-batch). Reports: elevated latencies, occasional 502s, and kernel pagein spikes. Start 1953456600.

oncall-berg: I'm oncall, taking lead. Initial triage: which routes are spiking?

sre-maya: /v1/generate-heavy (model: rw-13b-lw) and /v1/embed-large. Observed vmstat pagein/swapin spikes on hosts pool-euc-7. KV cache entries ballooned 20k -> 410k in ~6m. Paging causing severe perf cliffs.

eng-rajan: any recent config churn? Could be `max_num_seqs` set to 16 on that route + `max_batch_tokens` 32768. Those numbers will keep huge KV segments alive and cause paging.

ops-liz: I see a config push from config-sync at 1953456100 that modified runtime.cont_batch for r-euc-heavy. Patch shows `max_num_seqs: 16` and `max_batch_tokens: 32768`. That seems like the culprit.

infra-bot: kernel logs attached (excerpt): ```
May 01 15:10:02 host-pool-euc-7 kernel: vm_page_fault 68031 pagein
May 01 15:10:04 host-pool-euc-7 kernel: swapd: high activity
May 01 15:10:10 host-pool-euc-7 kernel: memory_pressure warning
```

oncall-berg: mitigation plan now: (1) immediately reduce cont-batch aggressiveness for the two routes, (2) flush KV caches on affected hosts, (3) if still unstable, disable cont-batch on route, (4) communicate to CS.

sre-maya: proposing concrete hotfix: set for r-euc-heavy and r-euc-embed `runtime.cont_batch.max_num_seqs=1`, `runtime.cont_batch.max_batch_tokens=4096`, `runtime.cont_batch.timeout_ms=25`. Stage 15% then ramp. Also run `redwoodctl kv flush --route r-euc-heavy --hosts pool-euc-7` to free RAM.

ops-bot: Job queued: redwoodctl patch route --id r-euc-heavy --set 'runtime.cont_batch.max_num_seqs=1' --set 'runtime.cont_batch.max_batch_tokens=4096' --set 'runtime.cont_batch.timeout_ms=25' --staged 15% --reason 'incident 1953456789 paging/kv surge'

eng-rajan: Also recommend a temporary cgroup memory limit on pool-euc-7 inference containers to prevent host-level OOM. If cgroups hit, we'll restart the container to recover page cache.

ops-bot: Patch applied: 15% -> 60% -> 100% at 1953456860. Rolling KV flush executed on pool-euc-7. Commands run: ```
redwoodctl kv flush --route r-euc-heavy --hosts pool-euc-7
ssh host-pool-euc-7 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference' (rolling) 
```

customer-success-omar: 4 customers reported degraded experience (LangLearn, MarketIQ, TutorPro, InvoiceMate). CS notified and posted interim status. LangLearn saw timeouts for 8m window.

sre-maya: after rollout and flush, memory and pagein metrics: pagein_rate fell 85%, KV entries stabilized ~36k, 95p latency down from 2.7s -> 380ms. No OOMs observed. Still monitoring for residual swap churn.

oncall-berg: good. Maintain monitoring for 30m. CS keep customers informed.

devex-olivia: quick note: put a stopgap in the config-sync pipeline to block any cont_batch updates that exceed max_num_seqs>4 OR max_batch_tokens>8192 without SRE approval. I'll open PR now and tag SRE.

eng-rajan: we should add an alert: per-route KV_entry_growth > 50k/min -> pagein_rate>threshold -> fire P1. Current alert didn't correlate per-route and came late.

infra-bot: action log: restarted 6 hosts in pool-euc-7 (rolling), flushed KV on 6 hosts. No crashes during restarts.

customer-success-omar: Update from LangLearn: recovered and thanked for fast response. MarketIQ had one retry window but recovered. I'll compile exact error IDs and forward.

sre-maya: quick runbook snippet for paging/KV incidents (to add to runbook): 1) Identify affected routes and hosts (kv-entry counts per host), 2) Stage reduce cont-batch params, 3) KV flush per-host, 4) consider cgroup mem limits & container restart, 5) fallback to quantized route if available, 6) notify CS.

oncall-berg: incident-bot update: severity -> mitigated. Lead: oncall-berg. Postmortem required: include timeline, config diff, kernel logs, and customer impact.

devex-olivia: PR created: config-sync guard + small CLI helper `redwoodctl config-validate --route ...` that checks cont_batch thresholds. Tagging @sre-maya and @eng-rajan for review.

sre-maya: follow-ups assigned: (1) rollback bad config source and identify author, (2) add per-route kv-growth alert, (3) add automated canary for cont-batch extreme values. I'll own 1 & 2.

oncall-berg: closing active mitigation thread. If new issues crop up, re-open. Thanks all :thumbsup:
